newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Massive foreign trade in Iscor shares.
newsitem.headline: Massive foreign trade in Iscor shares.

text.p: A massive foreign trade of some 37 million shares in South African iron and steel firm Iscor Ltd moved through the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Thursday morning, dealers said.
They said the deal, which had taken place overnight and been executed on Thursday morning, was worth over 120 million rand and had been executed by brokerage Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The brokerage would not comment on the deal.
Another JSE trader said: "There were about 37 million shares traded. It was a trade with a foreigner. That is all we know."
A spokesman for Iscor said the firm had no details on the transaction, but said that it was an abnormally high number of shares.
"The volume in Iscor shares is normally high, but not this high. Normal volume would be two to three million," he said.
At 0840 GMT Iscor shares were trading one cent firmer at 334 cents each.
